INSERT INTO vendor_settlement_summary (vendor_id, period_start, period_end, original_amount, pg_fee_amount, platform_fee_amount, final_amount, settlement_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{item.vendorId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{item.originalAmount}, #{item.pgFeeAmount}, #{item.platformFeeAmount}, #{item.finalAmount}, #{item.settlementCount}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE original_amount = VALUES(original_amount), pg_fee_amount = VALUES(pg_fee_amount), platform_fee_amount = VALUES(platform_fee_amount), final_amount = VALUES(final_amount), settlement_count = VALUES(settlement_count), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
